title: Good airflow
body: The fan has excellent airflow and is quiet. The build quality is good and the remote works well.
author: Example Reviewer C

title: Mixed experience
body: The airflow is good but the motor is noisy. Installation was difficult and service was disappointing.
author: Example Reviewer D

title: गुणवत्ता
body: इस पंखे की गुणवत्ता बहुत अच्छी है और हवा भी अच्छी आती है। आवाज बहुत कम है और इसे लगाना आसान था।
author: Example Reviewer E
